summary: The agent develops a competent ensemble of gradient boosting models with extensive feature engineering and optimized blending weights. However, it introduces data leakage by computing group aggregations and frequency encodings on the combined train/test dataset. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of the project approval data by using a randomized CV split and fails to account for potential target skewness by solely relying on RMSE.
